title: WorldBridge: Bridging Scattered Views for Coherent 3D World Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34079v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generating coherent and explorable 3D worlds from scattered images with little or no visual overlap is a fundamental and long-standing challenge in computer vision, which existing geometry-aware methods fail to address. Meanwhile, existing image- and video-based methods may generate unseen regions but produce inconsistent geometry across views. To bridge this gap, we present WorldBridge, a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation under scattered images with little or no visual overlap. WorldBridge encodes scattered references into a global scene context to guide geometry and appearance generation across views. Our temporal and spatial reference attention mechanism further enhances the fidelity of temporal references along the target trajectory and supports flexible spatial references outside it. A plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy improves reference fidelity through reprojection-guided test-time opt

translated_title: WorldBridge：连接离散视角以实现连贯的3D世界生成
translated_abstract: 从几乎没有或完全没有视觉重叠的离散图像中生成连贯且可探索的3D世界，是计算机视觉领域一项基础且长期存在的挑战，而现有的几何感知方法无法解决这一问题。与此同时，现有的基于图像和视频的方法虽然可以生成未见过的区域，但会在不同视角之间产生不一致的几何结构。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了WorldBridge——一个在几乎没有或完全没有视觉重叠的离散图像条件下，实现连贯且可控3D世界生成的框架。WorldBridge将离散的参考图像编码为全局场景上下文，以指导跨视角的几何与外观生成。我们的时间与空间参考注意力机制进一步增强了沿目标轨迹的时间参考的保真度，并支持轨迹之外的灵活空间参考。一种即插即用的潜在参考一致性策略，通过重投影引导的测试时优化提升了参考保真度。
tldr: WorldBridge提出了一种从几乎没有视觉重叠的离散图像中生成连贯可控3D世界的框架，通过全局场景上下文编码、时空参考注意力机制和潜在参考一致性策略，实现了跨视角一致的几何与外观生成。
en_tdlr: WorldBridge presents a framework for coherent and controllable 3D world generation from scattered images with little or no visual overlap, leveraging global scene context encoding, temporal-spatial reference attention, and a plug-and-play latent-reference consistency strategy to ensure cross-view geometric and appearance consistency.
